entry.title: notes on visual hierarchy
entry.content:
A quick write-up on visual hierarchy, mostly so future me stops relearning it.

why it matters

Visual hierarchy shows up across design work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Most of the value is in deleting, not adding.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
